# VisaApply.org

> VisaApply.org is the world's largest independent visa intelligence portal covering 249 ISO countries and territories, 14,084+ official visa categories, and 61,752 bilateral any-to-any routes with live processing times, fees, document checklists, and daily government auto-sync.

## Core Portal & Tools

- [VisaApply.org Homepage & 249-Country Directory](https://www.visaapply.org/): Explore all 249 global destinations, 30-second visa eligibility checker, and side-by-side visa comparison.
- [61,752 Any-to-Any Bilateral Visa Routes](https://www.visaapply.org/routes): Check Visa-Free, e-Visa, Visa on Arrival (VOA), and Embassy Visa rules between any two countries.
- [Cheap International Flights Search (249 Countries)](https://www.visaapply.org/flights): Compare flight routes and airfares for visa itineraries across 249 destinations.
- [2,490+ Official Visa Blogs & 2026 Guides](https://www.visaapply.org/blogs): Daily updated visa guides covering fees, rejection reasons, work permits, and student visas.
- [Consular Interview Prep & Mock Simulator](https://www.visaapply.org/interview-prep/us): Top 20 consular officer questions and winning answers for all 249 countries.
- [Full HTML Sitemap (14,084+ Visa Guides)](https://www.visaapply.org/sitemap): Complete index of all destination countries and visa subclasses.
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.visaapply.org/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable XML sitemap for search engines and AI crawlers.
- [About Us, Editorial Policy & Free Visa Widget](https://www.visaapply.org/about): Editorial verification methodology and embeddable visa status widget.

## Top Destination Visa Guides

- [United States Visa Guide (278 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-us): B1/B2 Tourist, F-1 Student, H-1B Work, L-1, O-1, and EB-5 Green Card requirements.
- [United Kingdom Visa Guide (222 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-gb): Standard Visitor, Skilled Worker, Health & Care, Student, and Global Talent visas.
- [Canada Visa Guide (151 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-ca): Temporary Resident Visa (TRV), Super Visa, Study Permit, Express Entry, and PNP pathways.
- [Germany & Schengen Visa Guide (138 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-de): Schengen C-Type Visitor, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), EU Blue Card, and Student visas.
- [Australia Visa Guide (135 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-au): Subclass 600 Visitor, Subclass 500 Student, Subclass 482 Skills in Demand, and 189/190/491 PR.
- [United Arab Emirates / Dubai Visa Guide (135 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-ae): 30/60-Day Tourist e-Visa, 5-Year Multi-Entry, Green Visa, and 10-Year Golden Visa.
- [Singapore Visa Guide (109 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-sg): Authorised Visa Agent e-Visa, Employment Pass, S Pass, and ONE Pass.
- [Japan Visa Guide (109 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-jp): Japan e-Visa, Short-Term Tourism, Engineer/Specialist in Humanities, and J-Skip.
- [Thailand Visa Guide (98 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-th): 60-Day Visa Exemption, Destination Thailand Visa (DTV), LTR Visa, and Non-Immigrant B/ED.
- [France Visa Guide (112 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-fr): France-Visas Schengen Tourist, 2/5-Year Cascade Multi-Entry, Passeport Talent, and Student visas.
- [Poland Visa Guide (92 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-pl): Poland Schengen C-Visa, Type D National Work Permit, Student Visa, and Karta Pobytu.
- [Spain Visa Guide (130 Visa Types)](https://www.visaapply.org/in-to-es): Spain Schengen Tourist Visa, Digital Nomad Visa, Non-Lucrative Visa, and Student Visa.
